text:
jonah_b: FYI Crestline procurement sent back the MSA + DPA with several edits. They want a 30-day POC in the order form, net-45 payment terms, and an expanded data-retention clause. Theyasked for signature routing within 48h or theymove to another vendor.

lucy_s: Can you paste the key redlines here? I'll track changes in DocuSign.

jonah_b: Key asks:
- Net-45 payment terms
- POC in order form: 30 days, acceptance criteria, trial fee waived if we approve
- DPA: retain logs for 2 years and add right to audit twice annually
- SLA: 99.9% uptime and credits expressed as days of service rather than percent

paul_g: Initial take:
- Net-45 OK for this account but finance must sign off (we have a $20k exposure band).
- 2-year log retention is heavy; propose compromise language: retention for security incident investigation and legal hold only, with max 12 months unless specific exception approved.
- Audit twice annually: reasonable if scoped to security controls and with notice.
- SLA credits: we prefer % invoice metric; can offer a flat-day credit alternative for enterprise only.

riley_m: For the POC: recommend 3-week pilot (customers often need extra time), up to 100k tokens/day, dedicated instance in eu-west-1 to meet data residency. Acceptance criteria: p95 latency <150ms, accuracy >= 80% on their labeling set. I can draft SoW.

lucy_s: Please drop the SoW text and desired order-form clause so I can patch the doc. Also confirm pricing if we waive trial fee.

riley_m: SoW snippet:```
POC SCOPE: Redwood will deliver a 21-day proof-of-concept with dedicated inference capacity in eu-west-1. Acceptance criteria: p95 latency <150ms; model accuracy >=80% on Customer-provided eval dataset. Telemetry access provided. If criteria met, POC converts to paid engagement per order form.```

jonah_b: Pricing ask from customer: waive fee. Proposed compromise: waive fee if they commit to a 6-month pilot on signing; otherwise $12,000 for the 3-week POC.

paul_g: Draft counters I plan to push: retain logs only as long as required for security incidents (max 12 months), limit audit to SOC2-style scope with 30 days notice, liability cap = 1.5x fees paid in prior 12 months. Also keep our standard SLA credit formula but offer one-time day-credit alternative for POC.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: signature-request created (DocuSign) id=doc_9921 routing: jonah_b -> lucy_s -> paul_g -> customer-sign

lucy_s: I updated the order form with Riley's SoW and the two pricing options. Envelope created.

paul_g: Uploaded redlines and a short exec summary for leadership. Finance please confirm exposure for net-45 and the waived fee scenario.

lucy_s: Finance: net-45 without fee is approved up to $20k; waived fee + 6-month commit requires finance approval (flagged).

jonah_b: Customer asked to see SOC2 Type II and encryption at rest details. I shared the SOC2 link and our KMS note.

riley_m: Operationally, to reach p95 <150ms we need dedicated priority on NVidia A10g in eu-west-1. I'll file a capacity ticket once signed.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: envelope updated to version doc_9921_v2 with Paul's redlines

jonah_b: Crestline responded: accepted SoW, pushing on liability cap and 2-year retention. They want VP-level approval for retention and higher cap.

lucy_s: @cto_maya and @vp_sales_raj looped for escalation per customer's request.

paul_g: I'll prepare a 1-page risk memo outlining recommended limit and retention compromise. If execs approve, we sign.

jonah_b: Need VP decision within 24h to keep timeline. If stalled they may pause.

ops-bot: :email: escalation reminders scheduled to @cto_maya and @vp_sales_raj in 6h.
